name: The Wolf Of All Streets
zh_summary: Scott Melker：今日加密總市值下跌 3.47% 至 2.74 萬億美元，即使 $BTC 上漲 0.57% 至 81,983 美元。$ETH 下滑 0.40% 至 2,417 美元，$XRP 微升 0.05% 至 1.30 美元，$BNB 上漲 0.51% 至 723 美元。$BTC 市佔升至 60.1%，$ETH 為 10.8%。24 小時清算 1.963 億美元，多頭佔 1.489 億美元。$HBAR 上漲 6.48%，$PUMP 下跌 4.61%。$BTC 持穩而更廣泛市場走弱。
en_summary: Scott Melker: Total crypto market cap fell 3.47% to $2.74 trillion today, even as $BTC rose 0.57% to $81,983. $ETH slipped 0.40% to $2,417, $XRP +0.05% to $1.30, $BNB +0.51% to $723. $BTC share rose to 60.1%, $ETH at 10.8%. Liquidations $196.3M over 24h, longs $148.9M. $HBAR +6.48%, $PUMP -4.61%. $BTC holding while broader market weakens.
text:
LATEST: Total crypto market capitalization fell 3.47% to $2.74 trillion on today, even as $BTC rose 0.57% to $81,983.

$ETH slipped 0.40% to $2,417, while $XRP edged up 0.05% to $1.30 and $BNB gained 0.51% to $723.

$BTC’s share of the market rose to 60.1%, with $ETH at 10.8%.

Liquidations across Binance, Bybit and OKX totaled $196.3 million over 24 hours, with longs accounting for $148.9 million.

$HBAR led gains among the top 39 assets, up 6.48%, while $PUMP fell 4.61%.

$BTC is holding while the broader market weakens.

name: Carl Quintanilla
zh_summary: FEDWATCH：當高知名度高收益發行人的股票與債券同時下跌時，進一步虧損是可能的。$SPCX 可能屬於此情況，它並非高收益評級，但仍追蹤 $CRWV 的收益率，顯示市場預期下一批炒作AI公司的IPO可能延至2027年。
en_summary: FEDWATCH: when stocks and bonds of high-profile high-yield issuers both fall, further losses are possible. This may be the case for $SPCX, which is not HY-rated but still tracks $CRWV’s yields, suggesting markets expect next IPOs from hyped AI companies may be delayed into 2027.
